reviews.title: The widgets side of this app is horrible and broken (themes are good though)
reviews.text:
I got this app so I could examine its selection of widgets for free users (ie those that didn't pay for the premium). Here are my somewhat organized thoughts. TLDR: if you want themes, you might like this app. If you want widgets, don't bother, it's broken.

Pros:
-no intrusive ads. Literally every other widget app has this in addition to random popups that take thirty seconds and three taps to get out of. You get a bonus star for this one.
-the theme selection is quite good. I've seen a lot of these themes elsewhere, so I know a lot of them weren't made by you, but at least they don't seem to be paywalled. I'd appreciate if there was a link to the artist that these themes came from; very few theme apps seem to have these, and I like it when artists are credited for their work.
-a custom widget maker that appears to have no paywalled options. When I first saw this, I was really excited, you can customize the background, text color, text font, it has transparency options (they rely on a screenshot of your background but whatever), so I thought it was a step up above other widget apps.... I'll talk more about this later.

Cons:
-there's a shaking gift box "buy out premium!!!" icon in the bottom right corner that you can't get rid of. At least some apps have the decency to allow you to exit out. You've lost your bonus star
-a bit laggy, for some reason. Maybe it's because I'm not on ios26 and the whole app has that liquid glass look? I didn't think that would affect things, I'm
